# rasuvaeff/property-testing-phpunit

PHPUnit adapter for the property-testing engine: a `PropertyTesting` trait
with a fluent `forAll()->check()` API over `rasuvaeff/property-testing-core`.

## Install

```bash
composer require --dev rasuvaeff/property-testing-phpunit
```

Requires PHP 8.3–8.5, `phpunit/phpunit` `^11.5 || ^12.0 || ^13.0`
(PHPUnit 13 requires PHP 8.4.1+; PHP 8.3 resolves PHPUnit 11 or 12),
`rasuvaeff/property-testing-core` `^0.9 || ^0.10 || ^0.11`.

## Rules

- The `check()` closure's **parameter names select the generators** from the
  `forAll()` map — a missing generator for a parameter throws
  `InvalidArgumentException`. `check()` validates the map before the engine
  runs: a value that is not an `ArbitraryInterface` throws
  `Property "<name>": forAll() expects array<string, ArbitraryInterface>, got int for key "x"`,
  a key that is not a parameter throws
  `Property "<name>": forAll() covers "x", which is not a parameter of the property`
  — with or without `auto()`.
- Setters validate at the call, naming the property:
  `Property "<name>": runs must be greater than or equal to 1` (`runs` ≥ 1,
  `maxShrinks`/`maxDiscards` ≥ 0, `timeoutMs`/`budgetMs`/`shrinkBudgetMs` ≥ 1);
  a `path()`/`PROPERTY_PATH` without `seed()`/`PROPERTY_SEED` is refused by
  `check()` the same way.
- Every outcome registers **one assertion** on the running `TestCase` — the
  check is the assertion, so a body without PHPUnit assertions is never risky,
  passing or failing (only a property whose every run was skipped registers
  none); every failing outcome throws **one `AssertionFailedError`**
  whose message is the engine's (seed, original/shrunk args, shrink stats) and
  whose `previous` is the engine exception (`PropertyViolationException`,
  `GaveUpException`, `CoverageViolationException`,
  `DeadlineExceededException`, `TimeBudgetExceededException`,
  `ExampleViolationException`, `RegressionViolationException`,
  `GenerationExhaustedException`).
- `Assume::that(false)` **discards the run** (retried by the engine, budget
  `maxDiscards`, default `runs * 10`) — it never skips the PHPUnit test.
- An explicit `seed()` **disables regression-corpus replay** for that
  property; the env `PROPERTY_SEED` does not.
- `forAll()` derives the property id from the CALLING METHOD's name, so call it
  directly from the test method — or pass an explicit id. From a closure the
  derived id is unusable: `{closure}` on PHP 8.3 (every closure of a class
  shares one corpus key) and `{closure:file:line}` from 8.4 (the key moves when
  a line is inserted above). Nothing throws; the corpus silently stops
  replaying. Pest's `it()`/`test()` bodies are the common case — call `->id()`
  there; the string is used verbatim as the corpus key, the event id AND the
  display name.
- `expectException()` inside a `check()` closure never sees the body's throw
  (the executor catches it first). Declare the expectation with `->throws()`
  instead: every trial must throw the class (a subclass matches) — a trial
  that returns normally or throws another class fails and shrinks. Skips and
  `Assume::that()` discards are unaffected. A non-Throwable class string is
  rejected with `InvalidArgumentException`.
- Environment contract and corpus format are identical to the Testo adapter
  and to frozen `rasuvaeff/property-testing` 2.8 — corpora interoperate.
- Generators, `Shrinkable`, `Assume`, `Classify`, `Gen::draw()`, state-machine
  testing: see `rasuvaeff/property-testing-core` llms.txt — all of it works
  inside `check()` closures unchanged.

## API

### Trait `Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\PhpUnit\PropertyTesting`

```php
final protected function forAll(array $generators = []): PropertyCheck;
// $generators: array<string, ArbitraryInterface>, keyed by closure parameter name
// The property id is derived from the CALLING METHOD; override it with ->id()
```

### `Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\PhpUnit\PropertyCheck` (fluent, all setters return $this)

```php
public function id(string $id): self;                // property identity: corpus key + event id + display name
public function runs(int $runs): self;               // successful checks, default 100
public function shrink(ShrinkMode $mode): self;      // Full (default) | Off | Bounded
public function shrinkBudgetMs(int $ms): self;       // wall-clock budget for the descent; costs determinism
public function phases(array $phases): self;         // list<Phase>: Examples, Corpus, Random, Shrink
public function derandomize(bool $on = true): self;  // unset seed derived from the property id
public function path(string $path): self;            // replay a recorded shrink descent; needs its seed
public function edgeCases(EdgeCases $mode): self;    // Mixin (default) | None = no numeric boundary bias
public function seed(int $seed): self;               // pin the random phase; disables corpus replay
public function maxShrinks(int $maxShrinks): self;   // cap accepted shrink steps; 0 = no shrinking
public function maxDiscards(int $maxDiscards): self; // discard budget; default runs * 10
public function timeoutMs(int $timeoutMs): self;     // per-run wall-clock deadline
public function budgetMs(int $budgetMs): self;       // whole-phase wall-clock budget
public function examples(array $examples): self;     // list<list<mixed>> positional tuples, run first, never shrunk
public function listeners(PropertyListener ...$listeners): self; // engine event observers
public function auto(bool $auto = true): self;       // derive missing generators from the closure signature; forAll() map = partial overrides
public function throws(string $exceptionClass): self; // class every trial must throw (subclass matches); no-throw fails with "Expected <class> to be thrown, but it was not"; a class AssertionFailedError is an instance of (\RuntimeException, \Exception, \Throwable) is refused — a failed assertion is never the expected throw
public function output($stdout, $stderr): self;      // redirect reports/trace streams (for tests)
public function check(\Closure $property): void;     // run the property
```

Auto-derivation (`auto()`, part of the core the package requires): every parameter the forAll()
map does not cover is derived from the closure's signature via
Gen::forParameters — the `@param` psalm type from the closure's docblock wins
over the native type; unreadable types (bare array, mixed, untyped, variadic)
throw naming the function and parameter. forAll() takes a `[]` default, so a
fully-typed closure needs no map. A map key that is not a parameter is an
error, with auto as without. Strictly opt-in, never the default (bare int/float derive their
full native domain). No PROPERTY_AUTO env variable, deliberately.

### Example

```php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Gen;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\PhpUnit\PropertyTesting;

final class SortPropertyTest extends TestCase
{
    use PropertyTesting;

    public function testSortIsIdempotent(): void
    {
        $this->forAll(['values' => Gen::arrayOf(Gen::int())])
            ->runs(300)
            ->check(static function (array $values): void {
                sort($values);
                $once = $values;
                sort($values);

                self::assertSame($once, $values);
            });
    }
}
```

### Environment variables

| Variable | Accepts | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `PROPERTY_RUNS` | positive integer within range (no saturation) | Overrides every property's run count; invalid value throws `InvalidArgumentException` |
| `PROPERTY_SEED` | integer within range | Seeds properties without an explicit `seed()`; `seed()` wins; invalid value throws |
| `PROPERTY_VERBOSE` | `''` = unset; `0`/`false`/`off`/`no` (case-insensitive, trimmed) = off; anything else = on (core 0.9: only `''`/`0` are off) | Trace: each run's arguments/draws, each accepted shrink step |
| `PROPERTY_DB` | directory path OR `redis://host[:port][/db][?prefix=key-prefix]` (`rediss://` = TLS; parsed by core `CorpusFactory`) | Regression corpus: record on falsification, replay first on the next run, prune on green. A DSN builds a RedisCorpus (ext-redis preferred, else predis; neither installed THROWS) — same document as the directory form, shared between CI and developers |
| `PROPERTY_PHASES` | `examples,corpus,random,shrink` (comma-separated, case-insensitive) | Stages to run; OVERRIDES `phases()`; unknown name throws |
| `PROPERTY_DERANDOMIZE` | same switch words as `PROPERTY_VERBOSE` | Unset seeds derived from the property id; `seed()`/`PROPERTY_SEED` still win |
| `PROPERTY_PATH` | recorded `CounterExample::$path` | Replays that shrink descent; needs the seed of that run; explicit `path()` wins |
| `PROPERTY_EDGE_CASES` | `mixin` \| `none` (case-insensitive) | Numeric boundary bias; OVERRIDES `edgeCases()`; unknown value throws |

### Classification output

`Classify::label()`/`when()`/`cover()` in the body work as in every adapter; a
passing classified property prints
`Property "<name>" distribution: label N% (n/checks), …` to stdout and a >90%
discard rate prints a narrowing warning to stderr. Each diagnostic line is
written as `"\n" . $line . "\n"` — the leading newline keeps it off PHPUnit's
progress row (the Testo adapter prints without it). Streams and format are
diagnostics, not a contract; match on the `Property "<name>"` prefix.

### Internal

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\PhpUnit\VerboseListener` — the `PROPERTY_VERBOSE`
trace as an exception-hardened `PropertyListener`; attached automatically,
not part of the public API.
